d: A foiled alleged mass shooting plot targeting a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois, has raised fresh concerns over anti-Indian and anti-Hindu hatred in America, amid growing online hate and anti-immigrant rhetoric. Meanwhile, sugar prices in India have surged up to 17% ahead of Diwali 2026, threatening to make festive sweets more expensive. Firstpost examines the rising hostility confronting Indian-Americans and the factors driving India’s sugar shortage, from lower production to rising demand, as authorities face pressure to address both concerns.
